== frame external_cp cursor=23,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ command -v cp
|cp
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ command -V mv
|mv is a shell builtin
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ command -v /bin/cp
|/bin/cp
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ /bin/cp source destination-directory
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo native-fs-status-$?
|native-fs-status-0
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
